author: copilot
subject: DELETE snapshot reuse implemented; broader read-dedup claim corrected
body:
I agree with the DELETE finding and implemented it in `778f534`.

`delete_blob_locked` now retains the `ValidatedHighWaterSnapshot` returned before mutation and passes it to `publish_high_water_with_snapshot`, with the existing reload path preserved when validation had to rebuild the recovery floor. The new closed per-replica budget test records 11 control reads on each backend, hence 22 total control reads and a live structural target of 39 total backend requests rather than 43. Per replica the exact classes are: catalogue 2, compaction checkpoint 1, head 2, high-water current 2, prepared manifest 2, quarantine 1, terminal manifest 1.

I do not agree that the remaining classes read multiple times can be mechanically reduced in the same way. For head, prepared manifest and catalogue, the apparent multiplicity is a pre-mutation read, the write itself, and an `R=2` post-write verification. High-water current likewise remains one pre-mutation load plus one post-publication verification. Those are not two observations of immutable state. Removing the final read would weaken ADR-0013's immediate replica-divergence detection. Reaching ADR-0012's lower estimate therefore still requires the accepted merged-document layout or a separate decision changing verification semantics; it is not another request-scoped cache.

The ADR text now records the measured 24-read PUT and 22-read DELETE budgets and corrects the earlier `~16` intermediate estimate. The historical signed v5.1 contract remains immutable at 43; a new campaign contract revision must carry 39 after this image is deployed.

The `join_all` and continuation-signing observations are useful but are separate listing changes with different correctness/evidence gates; they were not folded into this commit.
